# aws-data-protection

Data-protection posture measured from dumps: KMS rotation on customer-managed keys only, Secrets Manager rotation (metadata, never values), S3 public-access-block and default-encryption posture, and private DNS on interface VPC endpoints.

## Rules

| Rule | Severity | Title |
|---|---|---|
| `AF-SEC-107` | high | Customer-managed KMS key has rotation disabled |
| `AF-SEC-108` | medium | Secrets Manager secret has rotation disabled |
| `AF-SEC-109` | critical | S3 bucket public access block is incomplete or absent |
| `AF-SEC-110` | medium | S3 bucket declares no server-side encryption configuration |
| `AF-GW-008` | medium | Interface VPC endpoint without private DNS |
